statement: ∀ (c : CharP K p) (rho : LR.R p →+* K) (sigma : LR.R p →+* ZMod p) (hr : LR.ResidueMaps K p c rho sigma), letI := c; letI : Algebra (LR.R p) K := rho.toAlgebra; letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := ZMod.algebra K p; ∀ (s : Module (ZMod p) (LR.QMR p M)), letI := s; ∀ (hs : ∀ (r : LR.R p) (z : LR.QMR p M), r • z = sigma r • z) (t : LR.TransportData K p M) (d : Module.Basis (Fin (l+1)) (LR.R p) (LR.MR p M)), ∃ gamma : Module.Basis (Fin (l+1)) (ZMod p) (LR.QMR p M), ∀ i, gamma i = (LR.pMR p M).mkQ (d i)
proof:
classical
intro c rho sigma hr
letI := c
letI : Algebra (LR.R p) K := rho.toAlgebra
letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := ZMod.algebra K p
intro s
letI := s
intro hs t d
let g : Fin (l+1) → LR.QMR p M := fun i => (LR.pMR p M).mkQ (d i)
let delta := (d.baseChange K).map t.second
have hd : ∀ i, delta i = TensorProduct.tmul (ZMod p) (1 : K) (g i) := by
  intro i
  simpa [delta] using t.second_pure 1 (d i)
have hli : LinearIndependent (ZMod p) g := by
  apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff'.mpr
  intro a ha i
  have he : ∑ j, (algebraMap (ZMod p) K (a j)) • delta j = 0 := by
    simp only [hd, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', ← TensorProduct.tmul_smul, ← TensorProduct.tmul_sum, ha, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  have hz := (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff'.mp delta.linearIndependent) _ he i
  exact (algebraMap (ZMod p) K).injective (by simpa using hz)
have hsp : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span (ZMod p) (Set.range g) := by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (LR.pMR p M).mkQ_surjective z
  have he : (LR.pMR p M).mkQ w = ∑ i, sigma (d.repr w i) • g i := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← d.sum_repr w]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, hs, g]
  rw [he]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun i hi => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩))
exact ⟨Module.Basis.mk hli hsp, fun i => Module.Basis.mk_apply _ _ i⟩
